# Translations are generated by the Sync job and committed, not produced at runtime

The site supports several Locales from English Source text. Translating while the site runs would re-translate on every revalidation, make the site depend on a translation provider, and tie it to a host. Instead the owner-run Sync job translates changed Source text through a swappable Translator (Gemini free tier by default, local LibreTranslate as a second adapter) and writes the result to files that are reviewed and committed. Existing hand-written Translations are never overwritten; changed Source text only marks them as Stale translations. A new Locale is a list entry plus one Sync run.
